title: Composition and strict base change in logarithmic smoothness
statement: For locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], use log smooth and log etale in the chart sense of [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale]. Composites of log smooth morphisms are log smooth; log etale morphisms are log smooth; hence a log etale morphism followed by a log smooth morphism is log smooth. A strict base change of a log smooth morphism is log smooth, where strict means the source log structure is the log structure pulled back from the target. These properties can be checked on jointly surjective strict etale neighborhoods of source and target. For a nonempty coherent log ideal on an fs log scheme, its saturated log blowup, whenever it exists, is log etale. Finite saturated log blowup towers are therefore log etale.

source.place: VI 1.1--1.8, printed pp.69--70 (fs log schemes and log smooth chart calculus); VIII 3.3.8--3.3.11, printed pp.107--108, especially 3.3.11 explicitly asserting that saturated log blowups are log etale; X proof of 1.1 and 1.3, printed p.139 (preservation of log smoothness through log blowups). General composition and strict base-change chart calculus: Kato 1988 Theorem 3.5, WANTED locally. No Stacks tag states this logarithmic calculus.

proof.text: Construct identities and compositions with their actual relative section maps using [lem-sfb-log-morphism-operations]. A log-etale chart is log smooth directly: a finite whole cokernel is torsion, so the torsion subgroup has the same cardinality; an etale scheme comparison is smooth. This avoids an infinitesimal argument for this implication.

Use [lem-sfb-log-local-lifting-composition] to compose the two etale-local lifting predicates and the fs infinitesimal criterion to pass between lifting and chart smoothness. Underlying local finite presentation composes by the Mathlib theorem. This gives smooth composition and, using the preceding implication, mixed composition.

The generic strict log product lemma [lem-sfb-strict-log-pullback-universal] gives existence of the locally Noetherian fs product and the universal property for every representative, with arbitrary log test structures. Pair lifts by [lem-sfb-log-infinitesimal-pullback]. Scheme base change supplies local finite presentation, and the criterion now proves chart log smoothness of the new projection.

Apply the two pointwise chart equivalences of [lem-sfb-strict-etale-log-chart-transport] to each family member. The forward directions give the properties on every local map. For descent choose a preimage of each source point from the jointly surjective family, and apply the reverse pointwise equivalence.

Use [lem-sfb-saturated-log-blowup-chart-cover] to choose a compatible chart through each point of a saturated blowup. Bijectivity of its group map makes the kernel trivial and the cokernel trivial, hence finite of cardinality one; one is a unit in every local ring. The isomorphic comparison is etale. These are exactly the chart-log-etale conditions.

The identity has unique infinitesimal lifts by [lem-sfb-log-unique-lifting-composition] and its base is locally of finite presentation, so the criterion makes it log etale. The same lemma composes unique lifts, and local finite presentation composes, giving log-etale composition. Define all tower maps by dependent Fin.induction, taking identity at zero and composing each arrow with the preceding map. The constructed composites give the required CompEq equations. A second Fin.induction using blowup log etaleness proves every tower map log etale, including its last map and length zero.
